## Purpose

Describe the problem, the intended outcome, and why this is the smallest coherent change.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] `ruff check src tests` passes.
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] Documentation and user-facing limitations are current.
- [ ] No credentials, private infrastructure details, runtime databases, logs, or user data are included.

## Risk and rollback

Describe compatibility risks, security or privacy effects, and the cleanest rollback.
